title: OPM Federal Workforce Data (FWD / EHRI)
questions: how many federal employees work at each department
federal separations by type in fiscal year 2025
hiring and separation rates by agency
median GS pay by occupation or state
change in federal headcount since January 2025
share of federal workers eligible to retire

manual.how: Follow manual_download/opm/INSTRUCTIONS.md: run the bundled fetch.py on your own computer and upload the small data/ folder as a ZIP (best), or download the raw Parquet files listed in urls.txt, or on https://data.opm.gov/get-data/data-downloads click Download > .TXT (or .JSON) for each month needed; upload them and --ingest. No account or key is needed.

cache.why: Raw files are large (employment 26-75 MB a month), public and versioned by file name (employment_202509_4), so a cached copy of a version never changes; kept in <cache root>/opm-fwd ($OPM_CACHE_DIR overrides) for up to 30 days and reused across analyses. --no-cache deletes them after use.

redistribution.why: OPM releases the FWD files as public data under its Public Data Release Policy (U.S. government work, 17 U.S.C. 105); the filtered files may ship with a report. OPM itself withholds pay, duty station and related fields for DoD and security-sensitive agencies and occupations (published as REDACTED) to protect privacy and security: products must disclose that coverage, and nothing should try to infer withheld values.

citation: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Federal Workforce Data (FWD), Enterprise Human Resources Integration (EHRI) {dataset} files, accessed {retrieved_long} through the FWD API (https://data.opm.gov/get-data/api-access).

audit_hooks.why: Pay and location are REDACTED for about 45 to 48 percent of employment records: run stats.redaction_coverage() by the groups reported and save <out>/coverage.csv.
Data and Methods must say which records have pay or location withheld and how the estimates handle them.
EHRI excludes USPS and the intelligence agencies: the product must say the counts cover employees in OPM's data.

clarify: Pay or location: OPM withholds both for all DoD employees and for security-sensitive agencies and occupations (about 45 to 48 percent of records). Report pay where published (with coverage), exclude DoD explicitly, or limit to agencies with near-full coverage?
Counting actions: by the month they took effect (complete only after late reports arrive) or by the month OPM processed them?

Universe: all employees on board or the permanent full-time workforce (NSFTP)? For flows, do transfers between agencies count as separations, and transfers in (AA/AB) as accessions or new hires? OPM's dashboards count all accessions; fields.md calls only AC/AD/AE new hires.
Period: fiscal years (October-September) with September snapshots, or calendar years with December snapshots; how far back (monthly from 2011, quarterly to 2005)?
